topic: Car ride games that beat boredom
caption:
"Are we there yet?" Try these instead. 🚗

Three car games that need no screen, no paper and no prep. They work for little ones and big kids alike.
Great for errands, grandma's house and winter break drives.

What's your go-to car game?

#ParentingTips #LearningThroughPlay #CanadianParents #EarlyLearning #WinterBreak

title: Car-ride
word games
items: Rhyme chain: cat, hat, bat... who runs out?
Spot it: find something that starts with B
Add the digits on the next licence plate

scenes.sub: Kids love being the game master. Take turns and the car gets happily busy.
